angle: 다이소 1000원 행주 기사로 관심이 커진 지금, 쌀쌀해져 빨래가 잘 안 마르는 늦가을에 행주 쉰내를 잡는 요령을 모았어요
title: 쉰내 싹 잡는
주방 행주 관리법 7
subtitle: 빨아도 행주에서 냄새 나시죠?
scene: A bright, warm Korean home kitchen in morning light. A white countertop microwave sits on a light beige quartz countertop beside a sink with a stainless faucet. A small wooden dish rack, a ceramic utensil holder and a green plant are nearby. Soft sunlight streams through a window on the left. The bottom third of the frame is a clean, simple countertop surface. No text, no faces.
cover_image_prompt: Same kitchen set. A neatly folded stack of fresh white and pastel cotton dishcloths sits on the countertop in front of the white microwave, glowing in morning sunlight, steam faintly rising from a clean dishcloth, cozy and clean mood. No text, no faces.

tips.title: 쓰고 바로 빨기
lines: 젖은 채 두면 냄새가 금방 배요
tips.image_prompt: Hands rinsing and squeezing a white cotton dishcloth with dish soap foam under the running faucet.

tips.title: 활짝 펴서 말리기
tips.image_prompt: A dishcloth spread flat and hung on a small rack by the sunny window, drying in morning light.

tips.title: 끓는 물에 삶기
tips.image_prompt: A stainless pot on the counter with white cotton dishcloths in steaming boiling water, a long tongs resting beside it.

tips.title: 과탄산소다 담그기
tips.image_prompt: Gloved hands placing a dishcloth into a white basin of hot water with dissolving white powder and a measuring spoon nearby.

tips.title: 전자레인지 소독
tips.image_prompt: A damp folded dishcloth in a heat-safe glass bowl being placed into the open white microwave by a hand.

tips.title: 용도별 나눠 쓰기
tips.image_prompt: Three dishcloths in different pastel colors neatly folded side by side on the countertop.

tips.title: 냄새 나면 교체
tips.image_prompt: An old frayed grey dishcloth next to a new fresh white dishcloth on the countertop.

warning.title: 이건 절대 하지 마세요
warning.image_prompt: Same kitchen set, a crumpled damp dishcloth left balled up on the sink edge next to a bleach bottle and a vinegar bottle placed side by side, slightly gloomy. No text on labels, no faces.

caption:
행주에서 쉰내 나면 그냥 세제만 더 넣었어요 😅
행주 냄새는 빨래보다 '말리기'에서 갈려요.
쓰고 바로 빨아 활짝 펴서 말리고,
일주일에 한 번은 삶거나 과탄산소다에 담가 주세요.
삶기 귀찮은 날은 젖은 행주 전자레인지 1~2분도 방법이에요.
락스에 다른 세제 섞는 건 절대 안 돼요!
여러분은 행주 몇 장 돌려 쓰세요?
